fields.augment_rule_note: Cap + 4 overflow rows; each overflow locks 1 max Stress
fields.a_domain_ref: Sleeping characters do not use Domain Powers. Use half-step Effort, Resolve, Honed Edge, Recovery Anchor, and subclass Signature Moves instead.
fields.ancestry_note: Adaptive Spirit: once per session, after failing an action roll, spend 2 Hope to gain Advantage on your next roll of the same type. Cultural Bridge: during rest, mark 1 Stress to ask about a group's core motivations/customs. Silver Linings: complications still hurt, but reveal a small actionable opening.

fields.community_note: Scrap-Savvy Ingenuity: improvise a tool or simple device from junk. Roll Fear die: 1-3 works once then breaks; 4+ works reliably for the scene. Once per long rest, reroll by sacrificing a sentimental item to the project.

fields.features: STANDING REPUTATION — R E P U T A T I O N Sleeping Diplomats build influence the slow way: by being reliable. You may begin each session with two Reputation Tokens, capped at five.
fields.a_feattext: Spend 3 Hope to choose Plant an Idea, Create an Opening, or Gather Intelligence.
fields.s_feattext: Spend 3 Effort to choose Cite the File, Anticipated Move, or The Quiet Word: preparation replaces cosmic suggestion.
fields.s_move_0_t: At the start of a new political environment, spend a Short Rest mapping the informal power structure. The Keeper provides three significant relationships, debts, or grievances that are not common knowledge.
fields.s_move_1_t: Spend 1 Effort. You apply a piece of known leverage to an NPC during a social scene. The Keeper describes the NPC's resistance and what concessions, if any, are now possible. Successful application of leverage may also incur a permanent enmity, leverage is remembered.
fields.s_move_2_t: Once per story arc, you produce a sealed dossier on a named NPC. Its contents, if released, would destroy that NPC's position. You may threaten its release; you may release it; you may, most dangerously of all, use its existence as a private gift.
fields.wsec_feat: Taser Pistol 1d4 Stress dc 12 str or stunned.
